findings.reason: §3 names paths.py as the owner but does not add the constant, so the honest change is to publish the ids root beside JT60SA_DESCRIPTION_DIR (or let the settings default §8 adds carry it) and have the entry point resolve through that one rule, rather than the figure script spelling the literal.
findings.text: §3's interim fallback reaches the written pulses by composing `Path(JT60SA_ROOT) / "ids"`, but the owner §3 names for the /work layout, imas_ambix/data/paths.py, publishes JT60SA_ROOT (:45) and JT60SA_DESCRIPTION_DIR (:46) and no ids root, so the "/ids" component is positional knowledge held in the script (this is the only in-repo spelling of the ids root; the settings rule at imas_alambic/settings.py:134 builds it as `home / "ids"`, which the fallback re-derives with home=JT60SA_ROOT)

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — one function takes (root, pulse, run, series pairs) and hides the IDS file open, the DD-path extraction and the multi-panel figure layout behind a single returned object; §2's flux loops and §3's second pulse both become calls to it rather than parallel paths.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the interim pulse-root fallback composes the ids-root layout literal inside the figure script instead of extending the owner that publishes it.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §3 adds only a script-local function (no export, no CLI flag) and names what it retires, the E101154-fixed module constants SHOT/RUN/FIGURE/PULSE_FILE at scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py:32-35.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the three imas-ink primitives the design composes were verified to exist and be the right layer (extract_signal_traces at imas_ink/extract.py:815, time_trace_figure_mpl at imas_ink/figures.py:52, render_to_bytes at imas_ink/io.py:28), no existing generic «open a run file and draw DD paths» driver exists to reuse (the imas-ink CLI is demo-only; the MCP plot_time_traces at imas_ink/server/mcp.py:239 is equilibrium-hardcoded and returns base64), and §3 explicitly distinguishes the geometry script's `_read_ids` as a different product.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the change parameterizes the existing inline path in scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py instead of adding a parallel one, and §3 states why each owner is used directly rather than forked: imas-ink deliberately separates extract_signal_traces (takes an IDS object) from time_trace_figure_mpl (takes traces) and opens no files, so the file-open step is legitimately the application's.
